THE SYSTEM F-6 ARCHITECTURE IS DESIGNED TO PROVIDE VALUABLE OPTIONS TO DECISION MAKERS THROUGHOUT THE LIFE CYCLE DEVELOPMENT OF FUTURE SPACE SYSTEMS THAT ARE ABSENT IN PRESENT-DAY MONOLITHIC ARCHITECTURES.
